info.name: 🧺 Laundry Platform API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the multi-tenant laundry platform backend.

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8080`

**Variables:**
- `base` → `http://localhost:8080`
- `token` → JWT access token (auto-set on login)
- `laundryId` → Target laundry ID
- `orderId` → Target order ID
- `serviceId` → Target service ID

item.name: 🔐 AUTH
item.description: Authentication endpoints — register, OTP verification, login, password management.

request.description: Register a new user account. An OTP will be sent to the provided phone number.
Verify the OTP sent during registration to activate the account.
Login with email and password. ✅ Access token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` collection variable via test script.
Verify OTP for phone-based login flow.
Resend OTP to the provided phone number.
Get a new access token using a valid refresh token.
Invalidate the current session and refresh token.
Send a password reset link to the user's email address.
Reset user password using the token received via email. Replace `{{resetToken}}` collection variable with the actual token from email link.
Change the authenticated user's password. Requires valid current password.

item.name: 👑 SUPER ADMIN
item.description: Super Admin management — platform-wide control over laundries, users, and payments.

request.description: Bootstrap the platform super admin account. Requires a secret key configured on the server.
Login as super admin. ✅ Token auto-saved to `{{token}}`.
Retrieve platform-wide dashboard statistics — total orders, revenue, active laundries, users.
List all registered laundries. Filter by status: pending, approved, rejected, suspended.
Approve a pending laundry registration.
Reject a laundry registration with a mandatory reason.
Suspend an approved/active laundry.
Update the platform commission rate (%) for a specific laundry.
List all registered platform users.
Retrieve all payment transactions across the platform.

item.name: 🏪 LAUNDRY
item.description: Laundry registration, public listing, and laundry admin management endpoints.

request.description: Register a new laundry business on the platform. Requires authentication (user token).
Public endpoint — list all approved laundries near a given lat/lng location within radius (km).
Public endpoint — get details of a specific laundry.
Get the authenticated laundry admin's own laundry details.
Update the authenticated laundry admin's own laundry profile.
Retrieve laundry admin dashboard stats — orders, revenue, pending pickups, etc.
Onboard a new delivery partner for this laundry.
List all delivery partners associated with this laundry.
Toggle active/inactive status of a delivery partner. Replace PARTNER_ID in URL.
Create pickup/delivery time slots for this laundry.
Public endpoint — fetch available pickup/delivery time slots for a specific laundry.

item.name: 🧼 SERVICES
item.description: Laundry service management — create, read, update, delete, and toggle services.

request.description: Public endpoint — fetch all services, optionally filtered by laundryId.
Get details of a specific service.

body.raw:

request.description: Create a new laundry service. Requires laundry admin token.
Update an existing service.
Permanently delete a service.
Toggle the active/inactive status of a service.
Place a new laundry order. paymentMethod: online | cod.

query.description: pending | confirmed | processing | ready | out_for_delivery | delivered | cancelled

request.description: List orders for the authenticated user (or laundry admin sees their laundry's orders).
Fetch full details of a specific order.
Cancel a pending order with an optional reason.
Update order status (laundry admin). Flow: pending → confirmed → picked_up → processing → ready → out_for_delivery → delivered.
Assign a delivery partner to an order.

item.name: 💳 PAYMENTS
item.description: Payment creation, verification, COD confirmation, and refund management.

request.description: Create a Razorpay payment order for a laundry order. Returns Razorpay order details to initiate payment on frontend.
Verify Razorpay payment signature after successful payment. Marks order as paid on success.
Fetch payment details for a specific order.
List all payment records (laundry admin sees own payments; super admin sees all).
Mark a Cash-On-Delivery payment as collected upon delivery.
Initiate a refund for a cancelled or failed order via Razorpay.

item.name: 👤 USERS
item.description: User profile management and address book endpoints.

request.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile.
Update the authenticated user's profile.
Permanently delete the authenticated user's account.
List all orders placed by the authenticated user.
Add a new address to the user's address book.
Retrieve all saved addresses for the authenticated user.
Update a specific saved address.
Delete a specific saved address.
Mark a specific address as the user's default address.

item.name: 🚴 DELIVERY
item.description: Delivery partner operational endpoints — order accept/reject, OTP, location updates.

request.description: List orders available for pickup by the authenticated delivery partner.
Accept an available delivery order.
Reject an assigned delivery order.
List all currently active orders for the delivery partner.
List completed delivery history for the delivery partner.
Update the delivery status of an order.
Generate an OTP for order handover verification at delivery.
Verify OTP provided by customer to confirm delivery completion.
Retrieve delivery partner performance stats — total deliveries, earnings, ratings.
Send real-time GPS coordinates of the delivery partner during an active delivery.

item.name: 🔔 NOTIFICATIONS
item.description: Notification management — retrieve, mark read, and delete notifications.

request.description: Retrieve all notifications for the authenticated user.
Mark a specific notification as read.
Mark all notifications for the authenticated user as read at once.
Delete a specific notification.
Get the total count of unread notifications for the authenticated user.
